description: Shows the Padel USA Racket Finder as a tappable quiz card (level, style, feel, arm comfort, budget...). The shopper answers with a few taps and the card shows the 3 best-fitting rackets with Shop now buttons. Use it only when the shopper asks to take the quiz or wants to answer the questions themselves; otherwise fill in the answers yourself and call find_racket.
name: racket_quiz
title: Racket Finder quiz
